description: Lightweight Minecraft Fabric mod that adds a configurable in-game HUD with world and performance info.

mods.name: Show Me
mods.description: Mostra no HUD apenas as informações que você quiser (coords, ping, FPS, etc.) sem precisar do F3.

releases.notes:
## 🧭 Overview

Stable release of the **Show Me HUD** mod, compatible with **Minecraft 1.21.9**.  
This version includes internal adjustments to ensure compatibility with the latest game version and API.

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 1.21.9  
- **Fabric Loader**: `0.17.2`  
- **Fabric API**: `0.134.0`  
- **Java**: 17+

---

## 🔄 Changes

- Compatibility with **Minecraft 1.21.9**
- Compatibility with **Fabric API 0.134.0**

---

## 🛠️ Notes

- Compatible **only with Fabric** (not Forge)
- Lightweight and modpack-friendly

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
2. Place the `.jar` file into `.minecraft/mods`
3. Launch the game using the Fabric profile

---

Thanks for using Show Me!  
If you find any bugs or have suggestions, feel free to open an issue 😄
